name: agent-forge
description: Codex workflow plugin for adaptive, low-intrusion planning and agent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Codex work with explicit process controls.
interface.longDescription: Agent Forge provides Codex-compatible workflow assets for adaptive planning and lightweight agent orchestration. Its current Plan skill turns ambiguous software or workflow requests into draft-to-approved local Markdown execution plans with preset controls for exploration breadth, clarification depth, and read-only subagent use.
